name: Fate of the Phoenix
description: The recent centuries have witnessed the slow decay of our glorious [GetCountry('BYZ').GetFlavorRank]. Constant infighting, internal instability and the ongoing [ShowSituationName('rise_of_the_ottomans')] spell doom for us and our people, all while [GetCountry('SER').GetName] and [GetCountry('BUL').GetName] encroach on our northern border. Through sheer might and tenacity, we must put an end to corruption and restore the authority of the crown, before it is too late...

name: Golden Ambrosian Republic
description: A succession crisis has begun, and a rather unusual one: In the absence of a strong claimant to the throne, idealistic scholars are establishing a fledgling republic in [ShowLocationName('milano')]. These rebellious academics have already won significant popular support, and threaten to further destabilize the entire realm.

name: Aspiration for Liberty
description: The population's thirst for liberty and the desire to enact enlightened ideals have made their rebellion seemingly unavoidable. Their rage towards our perceived failure to rule threatens to explode into a revolutionary conflagration! This will make things far more difficult for us going forward...

name: [GetCountry('BYZ').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] Succession Crisis
description: Scheming pretenders and influential figures in the shadows plot to overthrow the ruling [GetCountry('BYZ').GetAdjective] dynastic line. Turmoil grips the court as powerful generals and outsiders bid to influence the outcome of this turbulent period. Our weakened presence in the [ShowRegionName('balkan_region')] is what has given way to this great uncertainty for the future of the last legitimate bastion of $ROM$...

name: [GetCountry('CAS').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] Civil War
description: Our enemies constantly look for ways to intervene in our politics, either by spurring instability or through supporting rival claimants to our seat of authority. This period of instability will surely reveal those who seek to end our rule and erase us from the pages of history. The wealth of [ShowRegionName('iberia_region')] has always drawn the hungry gazes of the foes on our borders, but we must not allow them to feast!

name: Ciompi Revolt
description: Florence faces a time of uncertainty as the Ciompi threaten open revolt. The Ciompi — made up of laborers, craftsmen, and artisans without guild associations — bear the burden of heavy taxation, yet have no political representation due to their lack of guild memberships. Such widespread unrest has the potential to plunge our entire society into discord...

name: Coup Attempt
description: Shadowy threats circle us like birds of prey, waiting to peck us apart — the most terrifying of which would bring about the untimely demise of our ruler! Worse, they would be replaced by a puppet, controlled from behind the scenes by these same murderous shadows.

name: Court and Country
description: Resistance to increasing centralization in our country has culminated in a period of general crisis and conflict between Court and Country. Depending on how we handle this difficult time, we might come out of it a stronger country than before — if we manage to weather the storm, of course.

name: Crisis of the [GetCountry('CHI').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip]
description: Heaven grows dark and grey. We are on the cusp of losing divine favor! Internal and external pressure grows; crumbling bureaucracy and agricultural failures have tipped the scales against us. The people no longer recognize us as the legitimate rulers of our [GetCountry('CHI').GetFlavorRank]!

name: Crisis of the Sayfawa Dynasty
description: Despite our dynasty's long and successful history of ruling this region, internal strife and a series of illegitimate rulers have precipitated a major crisis among us. While we are distracted with combating our internal strife, insidious enemies and our powerful neighbors will seize any opportunity they can to divide our lands and wipe our people from the face of the Earth. We must find a way to assert what has always been rightfully ours to the outside world without being consumed from the inside by corrosion within our own ranks.

name: Curse of [GetCharacter('ser_stefan_decanski').GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: No one disputes the greatness and grandeur surrounding the legend of [GetCharacter('ser_stefan_dusan').GetName]. Raised with the most excellent education, adept at court etiquette, and an accomplished commander, [GetCharacter('ser_stefan_dusan').GetShortNameWithNoTooltip] led our great nation to new heights. However, as royal intrigues go, [GetCharacter('ser_stefan_dusan').GetHerHis] legacy was built on suffering, murder, and skullduggery. The prime trophy taken during [GetCharacter('ser_stefan_dusan').GetHerHis] ascension was that of [GetCharacter('ser_stefan_dusan').GetHerHis] own father, [GetCharacter('ser_stefan_decanski').GetName], whose dying breath cursed [GetCharacter('ser_stefan_dusan').GetNameWithNoTooltip]'s line with decay and ruin. Superstitious voices across our court whisper that the visage of the old [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] has returned, marking the beginning of our end...

name: Death of [GetCharacter('maj_hayam_wuruk').GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: The passing of our great leader [GetCharacter('maj_hayam_wuruk').GetName] has thrown our [GetCountry('MAJ').GetFlavorRank] into great turmoil. This turbulent period could last many long years, as those who once bowed to us rise up against our authority. Disputed succession and the decay of our [GetCountry('MAJ').GetAdjective] power are two pressing issues that must be resolved immediately, if we want to survive this catastrophe.

name: Complacent Decline
description: Once mighty and unshakable, our domain now teeters on the brink of collapse. Corruption festers within our institutions, our provinces grow restless under the weight of neglect, and foreign powers circle like vultures, eager to carve up what remains of our glory. The golden age that once defined us has faded into memory, and the cracks in our foundation grow wider with each passing day. If we do not act swiftly to address the rot within and restore control, our empire will crumble, leaving only ruins and regret, a shadow of our former glory...

name: The Decline of $MAJ$
description: Our [GetCountry('MAJ').GetFlavorRank] is not as prosperous as it once was. Beset by internal dynastic conflicts, this period of weakness has long been anticipated by our rivals, who eagerly await any chance when to encroach on our borders. Now, with the rise of [ShowReligionGroupName('muslim')] in [ShowRegionName('indonesia_region')], we could easily fall from relevance and into the dark oubliette of forgotten empires...

name: The Decline of Mali
description: Weak rulership, civil wars, the rise of external threats, and internal stagnation are the primary challenges the [GetCountry('MAL').GetLongName] has faced in recent years. The stability and security of the [GetCountry('MAL').GetFlavorRank] is in peril, and only a strong hand can guide us out of this creeping doom and into glory once again.

name: The Dissolution of Delhi
description: Despite our best efforts, we have not been able to undo the damage wrought by our opposers. Our once great Empire has spiraled into chaos as our enemies surround us from every direction. This is truly a most dire situation and one that we must face head-on, lest we risk falling victim to the aggressive tendencies of those who covet our lands...

name: The English Civil War
description: Growing tensions between the Crown and Parliament over power and governance threaten to overwhelm the entire country. Our ruler's belief in divine right and religious policies have angered Parliament, as has [SCOPE.sCountry('actor').GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetHerHis] apparent ignorance of proper taxation procedures. The situation threatens to explode into outright civil war, unless we find a solution swiftly...

name: French Wars of Religion
description: As new branches of the [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('christian')] faith appear across [ShowContinentName('europe')], the subsequent religious friction created within our society has reached a boiling point. Now we are beset by armed zealots — heretics and defenders of the true faith alike — threatening to drag our entire realm into vicious civil conflict.

name: The Hook and Cod Wars
description: Our line of succession is unclear, and as a result, our political leaders have divided themselves into two factions. The Hook faction are generally more conservative and back established rulers, whereas the Cods typically favor independence and back those with less solid claims. This division has the potential to severely undermine the status quo, and should be handled with care.

name: Horde Civil War
description: Once again the authority of our ruler is being questioned! A rival warlord threatens the Horde with a civil war, hungry to claim the throne for themselves. The horde must march to war against its own renegade warriors...

name: Muscovite War of Succession
description: [GetCountry('MOS').GetCapital.GetName] is the seat of power in [GetCountry('MOS').GetCapital.GetRegion.GetName]. Due to a succession crisis, infighting has broken out between various family members of the ruling dynasty, each claiming the right to sit on the throne. Escalation in that conflict not only threatens to tear their family apart, but could have calamitous effects on us all.

name: Peasants' War
description: As discontent simmers in the countryside, the plight of the common folk grows increasingly dire. Unjust taxation, oppressive noble masters, and a sense of desperation have driven the peasants to the brink. A swelling tide of anger surged forth, leading to a cataclysmic upheaval that would come to be known as the Peasants' War.

name: Reform Society
description: The [ShowGovernmentReformName('altepetl')] system has served our people with care and prosperity over the years. However, our loose grasp on our subjects' concerns in other city-states has raised a chorus of dissenting voices against our rule. Should we wish to retain our splendor and consolidate our power, centralization reforms are necessary.

name: Religious Turmoil
description: Differences between the religious groups in our realm have become insurmountable, leading to a rise in intolerance and bigotry. We must ensure our people walk the correct path going forward, and guide those who have strayed back to the light.

name: Revolution!
description: Decades of feudal oppression, economic difficulties, and religious intolerance have taken their toll on the peace of our nation, and our population's desire for liberty poses a serious threat to our reign. A popular uprising is all but inevitable...

name: Revolutionary Chaos
description: The old regime is no more! We have overthrown our former oppressors and seized for ourselves. Yet the stability and security of our fledgling realm is still in peril, as rival factions fight over who should hold the ultimate authority in our nascent government. We must quash this internal turbulence if we are to remain stalwart against outside threats...

name: Rise of the $nobles_estate_szlachta$
description: We are no strangers to the power-hungry tendencies of the $nobles_estate_szlachta$. As $nobles_estate_szlachta$ influence grows, their rising demands for more privileges flood our court. These political maneuvers bring to mind a prowling jungle beast, circling and waiting to strike. Surely, they will seize the first opportunity to challenge our authority!

name: The Rise of Savonarola
description: An upstart preacher has begun spreading an apocalyptic message among our people. His fiery sermons denounce our corrupt, morally decayed society, especially those at the top. These ravings are causing quite a stir among our population — clearly, this madman has great powers of influence...

name: The Influence of China
description: The influence of [GetCountry('CHI').GetName] has been a boon to our society in many ways. However, our relationship with this cultural giant has woven many foreign threads into the tapestry of our society, disconnecting us from our traditions and threatening our independence. If we are to maintain our unique culture, we must resist further corruption from these seductive outside influences. Coversely, however, we might benefit from closer ties...

name: Struggle for Royal Power
description: Conflict rages over the authority of the monarch versus the power of the Sejm, and it appears our customary hierarchy will soon be challenged. We must decisively eliminate these threats if we wish to maintain the status quo. It is time we rid ourselves of the Estates' oversight and cease the reigns of power!

name: Succession Crisis
description: Our realm is in disarray! A powerful claimant has pressed their right to our throne against the wishes of our people. Our lands are now in mortal peril from both internal and external foes...

name: Time of Troubles
description: It is a dark period of social and economic unrest. Our nation is struggling with famine and war, as well as trying to brook opposition to the clergy and nobles. Beset on all sides by the dogs of strife, our realm is about to be ripped apart and devoured...

name: Turmoil in [GetCountry('BRA').GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description:
The [GetCountry('BRA').GetLongName] finds itself in difficult times ever since the power of the [ShowDynastyName('askanier_dynasty')] crumbled and the [ShowDynastyName('wittelsbach_dynasty')] assumed control of the $margraviate$. With the efforts of the [ShowDynastyNameWithNoTooltip('wittelsbach_dynasty')] bound elsewhere, the young [GetCountry('BRA').GetGovernment.GetRulerTitle] [GetCountry('BRA').GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetName] must struggle alone to re-assert the central authority in the [GetCountry('BRA').GetAdjectiveWithNoTooltip] March. Facing unruly estates, a population yearning for the days of [ShowDynastyNameWithNoTooltip('askanier_dynasty')] rule, and the ruthless Robber Barons will provide a difficult task for [GetCountry('BRA').GetGovernment.GetRuler.GetName].

While occupied with internal affairs, the [GetCountry('BRA').GetLongName] could also attract interest from other dynasties with a claim to the poor, but prestigious title of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Twilight of the [ShowGovernmentReformNameWithNoTooltip('tsardom')]
description: Even since the death of Ivan Asen II, [GetCountry('BUL').GetName] has been struggling with weak rule, noble infighting, and foreign encroachment. Burdened by internal division and external threats alike, the [GetCountry('BUL').GetFlavorRank] now faces a perilous twilight, one from which it may emerge renewed, or collapse into ruin.

name: War of the Union
description: Angered by excessive demands made upon them by the [SCOPE.sCountry('CAS').GetGovernment.GetAdjective] crown, two groups of well-heeled rebels have formed: The Aragonese and the Valencian Unions. Created by disgruntled members of the [GetCountry('ARA').GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')] and [GetCountry('ARA').GetGovernment.GetEstateName('burghers_estate')] classes, the Unions both call for constraints against the ruler's power, reduced taxation, and respect for local laws, privileges, and traditions.

name: War of the Roses
description: [GetCountry('ENG').GetName] is being torn apart by vicious conflict between cadet branches of the ruling dynasty, the 'white rose' of [ShowDynastyName('york_dynasty')] and the 'red rose' of [ShowDynastyName('lancaster_dynasty')], over whose hereditary claim to the rulership is strongest. This in-fighting could drag on for decades and affect the entire [GetCountry('ENG').GetGovernment.GetEstateName('nobles_estate')], completely undermining the stability of the [GetCountry('ENG').GetFlavorRank]!
